derivation: Counts and cases are parsed from the final full-run current JUnit XML files; focused test subsets are not substituted.

skipped_tests.reason: Assumption failed: A real native dialog requires a graphical display

evidence_boundaries: Core and desktop counts are JUnit test cases; separate host assertion counts and Python contract counts overlap and must not be added as independent JUnit tests.
Desktop includes shared production Compose render/semantics/pointer/key tests using synthetic hosts, not a native Android execution.
The single skipped desktop test requires a real native graphical file dialog; its exact reason is retained under skipped_tests.
Host logs exercise pure Java/Kotlin state models, stubs and source contracts; they do not establish Android Binder, Root, installer, lifecycle, permissions, real IME or device execution.
Release compilation/assembly is established by the final build log. Signing, APK hashes and certificate verification are maintained separately in the final release report.
The final Python log records 197 successful source-contract tests. Logs are preserved as recorded and are not rewritten to imply a later run.
